name: Silas's Hidden Warehouse
description: A maze of smuggling tunnels and cursed goods beneath the merchant's shop.

hidden_entrance.title: Hidden Staircase
hidden_entrance.description: A narrow staircase descends from Silas's shop into darkness. The walls are lined with shelves of mysterious crates. You can hear distant sounds of activity below—the warehouse is not abandoned.

main_warehouse.title: Main Warehouse - Central Chamber
main_warehouse.description: A vast underground chamber filled with crates, barrels, and mysterious goods. Some items pulse with dark magic. The ceiling is supported by thick stone pillars. Tunnels and passages lead in all directions—this operation is far larger than you imagined. Wagon tracks lead east toward a loading area.

encounters.description: Silas's hired guards spot you and attack!

trapped_vault.title: Trapped Vault
trapped_vault.description: A reinforced iron door stands ajar, its lock mechanisms broken. Inside, shelves hold ledgers and documents. A pressure plate trap is visible on the floor.

encounters.description: Poison darts shoot from the walls!

smuggler_tunnel.title: Main Smuggling Tunnel
smuggler_tunnel.description: A wide smuggling tunnel, tall enough to move goods through on carts. The walls are smooth and well-maintained. Recent footprints and wheel tracks show this route sees heavy use. The tunnel branches in multiple directions—this is clearly the main artery of Silas's smuggling operation.

cursed_goods.title: Cursed Goods Storage
cursed_goods.description: Crates marked with serpent symbols contain cursed items and dark artifacts. The air feels thick with malevolent energy.

encounters.description: Cultists guarding the cursed goods attack!

silas_hideout.title: Silas's Final Stand
silas_hideout.description: A small chamber with supplies for flight. Silas stands cornered, a poisoned blade in hand and desperation in his eyes. Maps and documents cover a makeshift desk. The smell of fear mixes with expensive cologne.

encounters.description: Silas and his elite bodyguards make their last stand!

loading_dock.title: Underground Loading Dock
loading_dock.description: A wide chamber with high ceilings and a subterranean river running through it. A stone dock extends into the dark water where small boats can deliver cargo unseen. Ropes, pulleys, and a crane system suggest heavy goods are moved here regularly. The water flows toward the sewers.

encounters.description: The dock foreman and his workers attack to protect their operation!

packing_room.title: Packing & Sorting Room
packing_room.description: Long tables are covered with wrapping materials, straw, and half-packed crates. Shelves hold various containers and disguises for contraband. A shipping schedule on the wall shows deliveries to multiple cities across Aerthos. Some crates bear innocent labels hiding sinister contents.

encounters.description: Workers scramble to defend the packing area!

foreman_office.title: Foreman's Office
foreman_office.description: A cramped office with a desk buried under paperwork. Shipping manifests, bribe receipts, and guard rotation schedules cover every surface. A locked strongbox sits beneath the desk. The foreman clearly kept meticulous records—damning evidence of the entire operation.

ritual_workshop.title: Cursed Item Workshop
ritual_workshop.description: A disturbing chamber where cursed items are created. Workbenches hold half-finished amulets, weapons, and talismans, all radiating malevolence. Ritual circles are drawn on the floor in what looks like dried blood. Chanting can be heard from deeper chambers. The very air here feels wrong.

encounters.description: Cultist artificers and their cursed creation attack!

cursed_vault_inner.title: Inner Cursed Vault
cursed_vault_inner.description: A heavily warded vault containing the most dangerous cursed items. Glass cases hold weapons that whisper promises of power. Chains bind grimoires that rattle and shake. Warning runes cover the walls—this is where Silas stored items too dangerous even for his customers. One case holds what appears to be a pulsing demonic artifact.

encounters.description: Ancient curse wards trigger, sapping your vitality!

demon_binding_chamber.title: Demon Binding Chamber (DANGER)
demon_binding_chamber.description: A nightmarish chamber with a massive summoning circle carved into the stone floor. Chains hang from the ceiling, designed to bind otherworldly entities. Scorch marks and claw gouges mar the walls. An ominous presence lingers here. This is clearly where the cult's most dangerous rituals were performed. The air crackles with residual dark energy.

encounters.description: Elite cultists and a partially bound demon attack!

tunnel_junction.title: Tunnel Junction
tunnel_junction.description: A three-way junction where smuggling tunnels meet. Footprints in the dust show recent traffic in multiple directions. Discarded contraband and empty crates litter the corners. Signs on the walls use coded symbols to mark the routes—one leads to the sewers, another to a secret exit.

sewer_connection.title: Sewer Connection Tunnel
sewer_connection.description: A narrow tunnel that connects to Oakhaven's sewer system. The smell is overwhelming. Water drips from the ceiling, and the sound of flowing sewage echoes from below. This must be how Silas moved goods in and out without being seen—right under the town's nose. Old rat droppings and claw marks suggest this route isn't always safe.

encounters.description: Giant rats attack from the sewer darkness!

secret_passage.title: Hidden Passage
secret_passage.description: A concealed passage behind a false wall. Unlike the working tunnels, this one is clean and well-maintained, with stone flooring and oil lamps. This was clearly Silas's personal escape route. A hidden cache contains emergency supplies and valuables—his insurance policy.

guard_barracks.title: Guard Barracks
guard_barracks.description: A long room with bunks, footlockers, and personal belongings of Silas's hired guards. A weapon rack holds spare arms. A card game sits abandoned on a table—the guards left in a hurry when the operation was exposed. Guard rotation schedules and pay records are pinned to the wall.

armory.title: Warehouse Armory
armory.description: A well-stocked armory containing weapons, armor, and supplies for Silas's guards. Weapon racks line the walls. A few higher-quality pieces suggest Silas armed his people well—loyalty through good equipment. Some items bear maker's marks from distant lands, showing the scope of his trade network.

merchant_office.title: Merchant's Office
merchant_office.description: Silas's personal office beneath his shop. An ornate desk holds correspondence with cult leaders, shipping manifests for cursed goods, and evidence of his crimes. A portrait of Silas in better days hangs on the wall. Hidden compartments in the desk hold blackmail material on town officials. This room contains everything needed to convict him.

trapped_corridor.title: Trapped Corridor
trapped_corridor.description: A narrow corridor lined with pressure plates, tripwires, and concealed dart launchers. Silas clearly didn't want anyone reaching his vault easily. Scorch marks and old bloodstains tell the story of failed intrusions. Disabling these traps requires skill and caution.

encounters.description: A gauntlet of poison darts, pressure plates, and blade traps!

flooded_passage.title: Flooded Passage
flooded_passage.description: A partially flooded tunnel where the underground river has seeped through cracks in the walls. The water is knee-deep and murky. Discarded crates float in the water—evidence of a smuggling mishap. The water carries a foul smell, likely from sewer contamination. Wading through here carries risks of disease.

encounters.description: The contaminated water threatens to sicken you!

collapsing_storeroom.title: Collapsing Storeroom
collapsing_storeroom.description: An unstable storage room where the ceiling has begun to cave in. Broken support beams lean at dangerous angles. Crates are crushed under fallen rubble. The structural damage must have occurred recently—perhaps from all the heavy goods Silas stored here. Dust rains from cracks in the ceiling. This area could fully collapse at any moment.

encounters.description: The ceiling gives way, raining rubble down!

storage_annex.title: Storage Annex
storage_annex.description: A secondary storage area filled with mundane goods mixed with contraband. Barrels of wine hide compartments of illegal substances. Crates of 'textiles' contain stolen weapons. This is where Silas hid illegal goods among legitimate merchandise—a classic smuggler's trick.

escape_tunnel.title: Escape Tunnel
escape_tunnel.description: A secret escape tunnel leading from the main smuggling route to Silas's final hideout. The walls are smooth, not rough like the working tunnels. Fresh torch sconces line the walls. Footprints in the dust show Silas fled this way recently. The end of the tunnel opens into his bolt-hole where he's making his desperate last stand.
